    tsdst.parallel.p_prog_simp¶

    tsdst.parallel.p_prog_simp(args, loop_args, function, n_jobs=2, verbose=True, use_threads=True)[source]¶

    Run keyword-argument tasks with an optional progress display.

    Parameters:
    argsdict

    Common keyword arguments supplied to every task.

    loop_argslist of dict

    Per-task arguments. A task’s values override duplicate common keys.

    functioncallable

    Function called with the merged keyword arguments.

    n_jobsint, optional

    Number of workers. One runs serially. The default is 2.

    verbosebool, optional

    Show progress when True. The default is True.

    use_threadsbool, optional

    Use threads when True, or processes when False. Process tasks require pickleable callables and arguments. The default is True.

    Returns:
    resultslist

    Outputs in input task order. Parallel exceptions occupy the corresponding output position as exception objects. Serial exceptions propagate.

    Notes

    The helper leaves the common and per-task dictionaries unchanged. It submits all parallel tasks before collecting results. For a bounded submission queue, use p_prog_simp_memorySafe. Process workers need an importable execution context, which can matter in interactive frontends.
